subject: Renewal of your catalog software license for 2027
body: Thank you for renewing with us for another year. This letter confirms the terms we discussed on September 30.
Your license for the catalog and circulation software renews on January 1, 2027, at $14,400 a year, the same price as this year. The renewal now includes the mobile app for patrons at no extra cost.
Please sign and return the enclosed renewal form by December 1, 2026. If you have any questions, call me at (503) 555-0147.
